title: Origins: Grassling
description: Become one with nature, become grass.
body:
Have you ever wanted to play minecraft as living grass? no? Yes you have! with this datapack you can play as the grassling origin, an impact 2 and simple origin.

The grassling powers and weaknesses are:

## Photosynthesis:
You can gain food from the sun just like a regular plant! all you need to do is stand in the sun and every 4 seconds you gain 1 hunger point.

## vegetarian:
You cannot consume meat, only vegetable and fruit.

## Flammable:
Being grass you are naturally quite flammable while dry so you take extra damage from fire.

## Frail:
You are a quite soft and delicate being so you have 2 less hearts compared to the average player.

## Tangle:
When hitting opponents they are slowed due to be tangled in the grass from your body.

## Internal storage
You can store items inside the tangle of grass that you are, gaining 5 extra slots of storage.

## weightless
You are really light since you are literally just grass, so you fall slower.
